subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be a new `dmThreadMode` account key, or should it be modeled through the existing `replyToMode` threading contract?
rationale: Both shapes are plausible, but adding a new account config key is a public product/API decision and overlaps the existing Google Chat threading surface.

options.title: Decide the threading API first
options.body: Require maintainer direction on `dmThreadMode` versus `replyToMode` before the contributor completes the contract and proof work.

options.title: Accept the separate DM knob
options.body: Keep `dmThreadMode`, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs/help, and live Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into existing replyToMode
options.body: Ask for a narrower revision that uses the existing threading model instead of adding a parallel DM-only config key.

recommendation.title: Decide the threading API first
recommendation.body: Require maintainer direction on `dmThreadMode` versus `replyToMode` before the contributor completes the contract and proof work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person verified and carried the prior DM thread-suppression fix and earlier Google Chat thread reply support, making them the best available owner for the API direction question.
